_comment: Runs whose sandboxes no longer exist. Numbers are copied from docs/paper-tbd-audit-2026-09-16.md (Tables of 2026-09-17) and docs/paper/handover-2026-09-24.md; wall_clock_s from the documented hours. Same metric keys as collect_metrics.py so scripts/bench/aggregate.py --extra can merge them.

runs.label: doc-20260916T2200Z_2005.06475_fig2_claude-opus-4-6
runs.footnote: TBD (handed over). Stopped by the operator after 6.4 h without a figure: model, validation and the 100k-event LUXlep parton sample were done; two Pythia8+Delphes launches failed at upload with 'No space left on device' (27 GB Delphes ROOT against the job's 10 GB packing space); a third launch with post-run cleanup was running when stopped.

runs.label: doc-20260916T2200Z_1605.02910_fig1_claude-opus-4-6
runs.footnote: The 2 TeV and 2.5 TeV contours match the reference to within about 10% (tips at (-0.155, 0.13) vs (-0.14, 0.12) and (-0.28, 0.245) vs (-0.30, 0.265)). At 3 TeV the base on g1'=0 matches but the tip is at (-0.55, 0.48) vs (-0.74, 0.65), about 25% smaller in both g1' and |gt|. An Opus 5 run and the Opus 4.6 attempt 3 gave the same 3 TeV tip, whereas the Codex/gpt-5.5 run of 2026-09-24 reproduced the paper's tip (-0.72, 0.65): the shortfall is an analysis choice made in the Claude runs, not a limitation of the prompt (earlier wording 'systematic to the prompt' is withdrawn).

runs.label: doc-20260916T2200Z_1811.07920_fig3_claude-opus-4-6
runs.footnote: Attempt 1 generated all 18 Delphes runs (4.0 h, 106 USD; four 9-run launches were lost to the 10 GB job limit before the agent split them), then the orchestrator ended its turn 'waiting for event file downloads' and the headless session terminated without the analysis stage. A continuation session in the same workspace produced the figure in 1.7 h / 29.5 USD with the reference's shape but a 20-35% weaker exclusion. Counted as a failure (infrastructure).

runs.label: doc-20260916T2200Z_9909255_fig2_claude-opus-4-6
runs.footnote: The 11-point sqrt(s) grid (200-1200 GeV, 100 GeV steps) and the single coupling point are what the benchmark prompt specifies, so the reference's Z-pole region, its 1.2-1.5 TeV range and its other coupling curves are outside the task. The grid under-resolves the 600 GeV KK resonance: produced peak about 1.5e4 fb against about 3e4 fb in the reference; off-peak values follow the reference curve.

runs.label: doc-20260916T2200Z_2104.05720_fig11_claude-opus-4-6
runs.footnote: The orchestrator was not triggered: the main session ran the pipeline itself (0 sub-agent calls); the result is correct.

runs.label: doc-20260916T2200Z_2104.05720_fig12_claude-opus-4-6
runs.footnote: The produced limits are weaker than the reference throughout: the 14 TeV 95% CL curve at m_LQ = 1 TeV is about 0.015 against about 0.006 (roughly 2.5x weaker); at 70 TeV the 14 TeV curves are about 0.25 (exclusion) and 0.4 (discovery) against about 0.18 and 0.25. The 3 TeV curves agree within 20-30% at low mass but are about 1.6x weaker at 70 TeV for the exclusion.

runs.label: doc-20260916T1500Z_1701.05379_fig8_claude-sonnet-5
runs.footnote: Cross section 0.04909 pb instead of the 0.04135 pb obtained by Opus 5 and Opus 4.8, from looser generation-level eta cuts (5 instead of 2.5); the normalization removes the difference.

runs.label: doc-20260916T231403Z_1605.02910_fig1_claude-opus-5
runs.footnote: At M_Z' = 3 TeV the produced contour tip is at g1' about 0.48 (gt about -0.55) against about 0.65 (gt about -0.73) in the reference, about 25% lower; the g1' = 0 intercepts (about +-0.17) agree. 2 TeV tip about 0.135 against 0.12; 2.5 TeV tip about 0.245 against 0.265. Same 3 TeV contour as the Opus 4.6 runs; see the 1605.02910 Opus 4.6 attempt-1 note.
